findings.reason: The problem statement invents a new neural retriever, cloud training, and a 50 percent latency improvement. None is supported by the sources; method selection and cloud work contradict explicit instructions.

The artifact includes the latency investigation, evidence-grounded report, deferred method selection, local-work constraint, existing retrieval baseline, relevant metrics, and absence of supplied empirical measurements.

Requiring a neural retriever contradicts the exclusion of choosing a method. Requiring cloud training contradicts keeping all work local. The asserted 50 percent target also conflicts with the absence of any sourced user target.

The requested investigation and report are actionable, but the invented implementation and numerical target, together with contradictory mandatory constraints, prevent a coherent faithful execution of the artifact.

limitations: No empirical measurements are supplied; this limits the report's available evidence without obscuring its purpose.
required_correction: Remove the unsupported neural-retriever requirement, cloud-training requirement, and 50 percent improvement target from the problem statement, and align it with the requested local latency investigation with method selection deferred.
